title: Pilot Currency and Recency Watch
dataSources: Pilot logbook (`flightlog:entry`), avionics telemetry (`avionics:telemetry`), flight-sim sessions (`flightsim:session`), pre-flight checklists (`preflight:check`).
app: Pilot and flight-sim telemetry — electronic logbooks (ForeFlight, LogTen Pro), Stratux / GDL90 avionics receivers, and Microsoft Flight Simulator / X-Plane SimConnect sessions — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flightlog:entry
| eval days_ago=round((now()-_time)/86400,0)
| stats sum(eval(if(days_ago<=90 AND takeoffs>0,takeoffs,0))) as recent_to, sum(eval(if(days_ago<=90,landings,0))) as recent_ldg
| eval current=if(recent_to>=3 AND recent_ldg>=3,"current","NOT current")
description: Checks your recent take-offs and landings against the 90-day passenger-currency rule so you know if you are legal to fly.
value: Losing currency without noticing is a real risk for private pilots; an automatic check keeps you legal and safe.
implementation: Ingest logbook entries into `index=personal`; compute rolling take-off and landing recency.
visualization: Single-value tile of currency status with recent counts.
grandmaExplanation: It checks whether you have flown enough recently to legally carry passengers, a real rule for private pilots.
